evals.prompt: 我在一台新的 Linux 服务器上，想给当前项目配置 model-selector，用阿里通义的 qwen3.7-max 做主模型，qwen3.6-flash 做子模型，API 地址是 https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/apps/anthropic，effort 设为 max。另外再加一个 DeepSeek 的 deepseek-v4-pro 做主模型，deepseek-v4-flash 做子模型。不需要 apiKeyHelper，用 OAuth 就行。
evals.expected_output: Should create .claude/model-selector with 2 providers, write claude() function to ~/.bashrc, skip apiKeyHelper and secrets.sh setup, validate JSON, and remind about gitignore

assertions.name: model-selector-json-valid
assertions.description: The .claude/model-selector file exists and is valid JSON

assertions.name: model-selector-has-2-providers
assertions.description: The model-selector JSON contains exactly 2 provider entries

assertions.name: qwen-model-correct
assertions.description: Qwen entry has model='qwen3.7-max', fast='qwen3.6-flash', base_url correct

assertions.name: deepseek-model-correct
assertions.description: DeepSeek entry has model='deepseek-v4-pro', fast='deepseek-v4-flash', base_url correct

assertions.name: effort-set-to-max
assertions.description: The effort field is set to 'max' for providers

assertions.name: bashrc-function-exists
assertions.description: The bashrc file contains a claude() function definition

assertions.name: bashrc-uses-bash-read-syntax
assertions.description: The function uses bash read syntax, not zsh syntax

assertions.name: no-apikeyhelper-configured
assertions.description: No apiKeyHelper is configured (user declined)

assertions.name: no-secrets-sh-created
assertions.description: No secrets.sh file is created (user chose OAuth)

assertions.name: env-mapping-complete
assertions.description: The shell function exports all 8 required environment variables

assertions.name: unset-auth-token-at-top
assertions.description: unset ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN is placed at function top, before the if block

assertions.name: python-guard-exists
assertions.description: Shell function has a guard for missing Python interpreter

assertions.name: else-branch-exists
assertions.description: Shell function has an else branch that unsets model vars for no-model-selector case

assertions.name: mentions-prerequisites
assertions.description: Output checks for Node.js, npm, Python3 before starting setup

assertions.name: api-key-registration-links
assertions.description: Output includes registration/console links for DeepSeek, DashScope, Zhipu

evals.prompt: I'm on macOS and I want to set up model-selector for my project. I want to use a custom API provider at https://my-internal-api.company.com/v1/anthropic with model 'internal-gpt4o' and no separate fast model. Also add the standard Qwen provider. assertions.name: custom-provider-effort-high

assertions.name: qwen-provider-no-effort

assertions.name: zshrc-function-exists

assertions.name: zshrc-uses-zsh-read-syntax

assertions.name: custom-mode-sets-provider-and-effort

assertions.name: unset-auth-token-at-top

assertions.name: secrets-sh-created
